standard_prerequisites.name: The behaviour of the class of (A, n, c)-modules under short exact sequences
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source line 5176 and attributed to a lemma of another chapter (a cross-chapter pointer)
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the proof to replace the given module by a resolution by free modules over the quotient and keep control of the constants.

core_obligations: Resolve the module: the proof chooses a short exact sequence presenting the module as a quotient of a finite free module over the quotient ring and records that the kernel is again a module of the same uniform type (proof lines 5173-5180)

The top two degrees: for the two highest indices the proof shows the cohomology vanishes outright, using the resolution and the vanishing statements available for the structure sheaves (proof lines 5180-5240)

The intermediate degrees: for indices strictly between zero and the top the proof shows the comparison map between the shifted cohomologies is zero, by pushing the argument along the resolution (proof lines 5240-5280)

The remaining cases: for index zero the proof produces the stated surjection when the dimension parameter is at most one, and in the higher-dimensional case it shows the image of the comparison map is contained in the image of the canonical map from the ideal power, reducing the last claim to the same computation as in the intermediate case (proof lines 5284-5290)
proof_roadmap: 先取短正合列 0 → K → (A/I^n)^{⊕r} → M → 0，并注意 K 仍是同型的 (A,n,c)-模。
沿此分解逐条处理五种情形：最高两阶直接消失；中间阶的比较映射为零；i = 0 时 d ≤ 1 给满射、d > 1 时把像包含关系化归到与中间阶相同的论证。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects five case-by-case vanishing and comparison assertions for the cohomology of the pullback of a uniformly annihilated module (author lemma at source lines 5144-5171, label lemma-vanishing-coh-almost-projective). The proof (source lines 5173-5290) resolves the module by a finite free module over the quotient, keeping the uniform type of the kernel, and then treats the five cases in turn: vanishing in the top two degrees, the vanishing of the comparison map in intermediate degrees, and the two forms of the statement for degree zero, the last of which is reduced to the same computation as the intermediate case (proof lines 5284-5290). The resolution and the case analysis are the content. H2.
